purpose: Dual foliar pathology classification and pest detection on crops with regulatory-backed CIBRC treatment recommendations (chemical, biological, cultural).
output_format: Structured AgricultureDiseaseResult containing diagnosis (pathology/pest, confidence, healthy check), severity, provenance, warnings, and CIBRC-aligned chemical, biological, and cultural treatments
dataset_name: PlantVillage Benchmark (54,306 images) + IP102 Large-scale Pest Benchmark (75,222 images) + CIBRC Regulatory Database
known_limitations: Disease classifier trained primarily on single-leaf macro photographs; complex field canopies require cropping to diseased foliage.
Model weights (~81.8 MB and ~38.3 MB) exceed recommended standard Git commit thresholds and require dynamic Hugging Face caching or Git LFS.
Requires PyTorch (CPU or CUDA) and Ultralytics dependencies.
